candidates.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Draw a new, compact frozen launcher icon headshot of AnkiQuest's own Ankilope. Use the first reference for exact Ankilope face and the second for frost on the horn and ear tips. Third reference is Aki's current frozen launcher icon, only an example of sizing and the protective ice shield cue. Ankilope has golden-tan softly brushed fur, cream eyebrows and muzzle, large brown eyes, long brown-edged antelope ears, two curved ribbed dark-brown horns and a little indigo scarf under the chin. Face looks calmly relieved. Draw a single small ice-blue frosted shield with a clearly defined little golden flame centered below her chin at the scarf, and a tiny rim of frost on horn and ear tips. Keep Ankilope's own silhouette and palette. Head, horns and scarf knot only. Compact centered finished cutout within central 70% of 1254×1254 RGBA transparent square, design legible at 48 px. Strong soft outlines, no body, legs, text, enclosing tile, atmospheric halo, ground shadow or any opaque background.

Use case: illustration-story. Draw the frozen launcher icon for Bluma, the AnkiQuest purple cow, as a new compact headshot. Reference 1 gives exact headshape and colors: violet soft-brushed fur, lavender swoop of hair, broad cream muzzle with two oval nostrils, large warm brown eyes, cream eyebrow spots, short cream horns, wide ears with pale blush interior, deep indigo scarf. Reference 2 gives Bluma's gentle frozen expression and light blue. Reference 3 is only the size and icy streak-protection badge language. Put a small clearly outlined pale-blue ice shield with a warm amber flame just under the chin, and a dusting of sky-blue frost on her short horn tips. Make her smile gently, comfortable and protected. Head and a little scarf only, fully centered with padding similar to Aki. Strong outline and simple shapes legible at 48 px. Transparent 1254×1254 RGBA square with no ground, body, bag, lettering, opaque tile, or atmospheric glow. No red panda or antelope features.

Use case: illustration-story. Draw one new frozen launcher icon headshot of Anki-tan by Shigeyuki, derivative CC BY-SA 4.0. First reference gives the approved frozen drawing and identity: light sky-blue bangs and hair, a white band with exactly three bright blue five-point stars (large central and smaller side stars), warm pale face with expressive eyes, gentle soft gray-and-blue palette. Second reference gives the original compact launcher head silhouette. Third reference supplies only an icy streak-protection shield cue and the generous centered padding. Draw a crisp hand-inked and softly pencil-colored head with a reassuring little smile, compact lock of hair on each side; a small pale-blue ice shield with one warm amber flame below the chin and one simple snowflake near it. Keep the headband and face prominent at 48 px. Head and no torso, direct transparent cutout, all details inside a centered safe circular area. Requested 1254×1254 transparent RGBA square. No typography, backdrop, tile, white glow, smoke, text, red panda parts, or cut-off hair.
